svg.title: Galaxy Tab S12+ — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. Portrait, 10 units/mm. Body 187.8 × 289.5 mm; centered display derived from 320.4 mm full-rectangle diagonal and 1752 × 2800 pixels. Original illustration: placement, corner radii, camera details and finish swatches are approximations. Sources: https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-introduces-galaxy-tab-s12-series-the-ultimate-productivity-powerhouse-built-for-growth; https://www.samsung.com/uk/tablets/galaxy-tab-s/galaxy-tab-s12-plus-silver-256gb-sm-x840nzsreub/
